Name: NBLOCA TRE
Description: The NBLOCA TRE allows the NITF image to be accessed in a random or parallel fashion by providing the ability to find the offset to the location of th efirst data byte of any frame or block. This offset is determined by summing the offset values for the previous blocks and allows direct access to a frame without reading through any portion of the image frames.

FRAME_1_OFFSET.Name: First Image Frame Offset
FRAME_1_OFFSET.Description: This field contains the first image frame offset, from the beginning of the NITF image subheader. The value for this field is stored in a 4-byte unsigned binary integer. This offset is equal to the size of the image subheader. Bytes are ordered from the most significant to the least significant.

NUMBER_OF_FRAMES.Name: Number of Blocks
NUMBER_OF_FRAMES.Description: This field contains the number of blocks for which offsets are listed. The value for this field is stored in a 4-byte unsigned binary integer. The bytes are ordered from the most significant to the least significant.

FRAME_OFFSET<NUMBER_OF_FRAMES>.Name: Frame Offset
FRAME_OFFSET<NUMBER_OF_FRAMES>.Description: This field contains the offset in bytes of the beginning of the nth image frame from the beginning of the N-1 image frame. The value for this field is stored in a 4-byte unsigned binary integer. The bytes are ordered from the most significant to the least significant.
